snow.config.title: Snow
snow.config.option.description.accumulat: This lets each biome have its own snowfall rate, you can modify this using a datapack.
snow.config.option.description.generatio: If enabled, snowy biomes will generate with several layers of snow instead of just one.
snow.config.option.description.canopy.sn: When enabled, snow falls and generates on the ground beneath tree canopies.
snow.config.option.description.melting.g: When enabled, snow melts one layer at a time instead of disappearing all at once.
snow.config.option.description.melting.m: If enabled snow will melt in biomes that are warm enough to rain.
snow.config.option.description.harvestin: Using a shovel on snow clears it and drops snowballs.
snow.config.option.description.snowloggi: If enabled, snow can cover small plants like flowers and grass - similar to waterlogging.
